text: Alright, sign in here. Mr Vance said there was an audit today. He's not happy about it, fair warning.
style: Site security guard on the early shift, mid-fifties. Speak with a consistent West Country (Bristol) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, even pitch; unhurried pace. Polite and a little grumpy about the hour, then firmly by-the-book once pushed.
